highest_reported.metric: maximum shortest-path length divided by Euclidean chord length

reproduced_witness.provenance: Rebuilt UBC 6-fan; exact combinatorial check and rational interval distance evaluation.

open_status.evidence: Fekete, Keldenich, and Perk (2026) report optimal solutions for regular n-gons up to n=100. Their range does not include n=120. The source review on 2026-11-06 found no same-parameter proof closing the 120-gon case.
open_status.source_location: Abstract; regular n-gon results and computations for n=4 through 100
open_status.claim_limit: The checked sources do not establish optimality for n=120; this is not an exhaustive literature survey.

independent_quantity.method: Cyclotomic cosine minimal polynomial, exact rational Horner and square-root chord bounds, all-pairs integer Floyd-Warshall.

parameters.polygon: regular convex 120-gon, vertices in counterclockwise cyclic order
parameters.construction: straight-line triangulation using polygon vertices only
parameters.objective: minimize over triangulations the maximum, over distinct vertex pairs, of shortest-path length divided by Euclidean chord length

best_human.evidence_state: same-parameter witness and certified score reproduced; score is the interval upper endpoint rounded upward
